statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
These symptoms raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia
The service is to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic events
The service is to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service was rejected because it is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
